svg.title: RoadAnomaly — C4 system context
svg.desc: C4 context diagram: a road-safety analyst checks photos in the product, a reviewer compares the models in the demo and on the landing page, and the six data scientists train and evaluate them in notebooks. RoadAnomaly reads the vendored RoadAnomaly dataset, downloads ImageNet weights once, deploys its static landing page to Vercel and pushes its images to Docker Hub.
